messages.subject: Re: Build Errors on Server, Works on Local
parts:
Your application as currently deployed does not, in fact, contain libraries.R (or the other R files loaded with source()).
You can verify this by going to the shinyapps.io dashboard, to the application in question, and clicking the download button on the Overview.
Double check how your project directory is organized and make sure that when you deploy you haven't accidentally unchecked the files.
